posts.text: V2 Retail - Q1 FY 27 results and concall highlights - Revenues - 997 vs 632 cr, up 58 pc Gross profits - 285 vs 186 cr, up 53 pc ( GMs @ 28.6 vs 29.5 pc ) EBITDA - 139 vs 87 cr, up 60 pc ( margins @ 14 vs 13.8 pc ) PAT - 42 vs 25 cr, up 70 pc Opened 57 stores in Q1, taking the total store count to 381 ( also closed 1 store in Q1 ) SSSG @ 7.5 pc Volume growth @ 56 pc Avg Bill Value @ Rs 941 vs Rs 901 in Q1 LY Avg Selling price @ 308 vs 303 in Q1 LY MRP sales @ 90 pc vs 92 pc in Q1 LY NWC days @ 74 days - compared to 81 days @ the end of Q4 FY 26 Pre Ind AS - EBITDA @ 80 vs 52 cr, up 51 pc Margi…
